No Hoje frame shows a single-run day in the V1 data set (572:1379, the long-run day, is tagged FUTURO).

captureBlocker: NO_CAPTURE_PATH: `sim.sh run` launches the app with only -AppleLanguages/-AppleLocale. The fixture composition needs the `-scenario <id>` launch argument (LaunchMode.of, Debug only), and sim.sh has no option to pass it, so every sim.sh run opens the live composition. (Hoje is the fixture launch screen, so only --scenario is missing for this one.) No hand-made or XCUITest screenshot substitutes for a sim.sh run (VISUAL_VALIDATION.md). Needs: sim.sh --scenario (ORCH) and a launch route to this screen (front C), or an agreed capture path.
